battle.name: 第三次突厥-波斯戰爭
battle.theater: 美索不達米亞平原與亞美尼亞
battle.brief: 公元627年春，拜占庭皇帝赫拉克利亞斯自君士坦丁堡出發，轉戰高加索，圍攻波斯重鎮甘察加，並在十二月十二日的尼尼微之戰中擊敗沙赫爾巴茲率領的波斯軍，兵鋒直抵泰西封。卡面的投石機是羅馬時代的扭力式拋石器；本役真正發揮作用的是拜占庭在安條克製造、以配重驅動的「赫勒波利斯」。

kit.name: 投石機
kit.history: 把絞盤的勢能換成一塊石頭。攻城從此有了可以計算的破壞力。

countries: 本場戰爭即中文所稱的第三次突厥-波斯戰爭，指拜占庭（東羅馬）帝國與薩珊波斯帝國之間的第三次大規模交鋒，戰爭的高潮落在627年，最後以631年前後簽訂的和約收束。交戰一方是皇帝赫拉克利亞斯自610年起執掌的拜占庭：627年遠征時皇帝本人自任主帥，帳下有波斯裔將領納爾西斯、亞美尼亞盟軍將領瓦漢，以及格魯吉亞與亞美尼亞的援軍部隊；中央政府留在君士坦丁堡，由攝政與宮廷主持糧秣、兵員與海運的供應，而帝國的東部邊軍同時在亞美尼亞、高加索與美索不達米亞三條戰線上被薩珊牽制，錢糧都得從地中海兩岸與黑海沿岸的稅收中抽取。另一方是薩珊波斯：皇帝赫斯羅二世坐鎮泰西封，東線大軍交由沙赫爾巴茲指揮，西北戰線另有沙欣等將領各自作戰；波斯在亞美尼亞、兩河與高加索同時展開攻勢，兵力分散、後勤線拉長，是它在627年被反推的結構性弱點。戰爭並非只有兩方：草原聯盟的可薩汗與赫斯羅二世結盟，617至618年以大軍包圍君士坦丁堡，令拜占庭無法傾全力東進；而亞美尼亞、格魯吉亞的反抗者，以及被波斯強迫改宗、又淪為其軍官的亞美尼亞貴族，也在邊境上提供游擊、騷擾與情報。拜占庭與波斯之間還有第三種關係：亞美尼亞與格魯吉亞的教會是雙方都想爭取的盟友，誰能護住修道院與教堂，誰就能在當地換到糧食、嚮導與兵源。
countriesEn: This war is the one called in Chinese the Third Turkic-Persian War: the third great confrontation between the Byzantine (Eastern Roman) Empire and the Sasanian Empire of Persia, fought in substance between 602 and 628, with its climax in 627 and its end in a treaty signed around 631. One side was the Byzantine Empire under Emperor Heraclius, who had taken the throne in 610: in the campaign of 627 he commanded in person, with the Persian-born general Narses, the Armenian commander Vahan, and Georgian and Armenian contingents under his orders, while the central government stayed in Constantinople, where regents and the palace administration handled money, food, men and the sea transport; the eastern armies of the empire were pinned on three fronts at once, in Armenia, in the Caucasus and in Mesopotamia, and all of them drew on the tax revenues of the Mediterranean and Black Sea coasts. The other side was Sasanian Persia: Khosrow II sat at Ctesiphon, the army in the east was commanded by Shahrbaraz, and generals such as Shahin led separate columns in the north-west; simultaneous offensives in Armenia, the Two Rivers and the Caucasus stretched Persia's troops thin and lengthened its supply lines, and that structural weakness is what the war of 627 exposed. It was not a two-sided war, however. The Khagan of the steppe confederation had an alliance with Khosrow and ringed Constantinople with a great army in 617 and 618, pinning the Byzantines in the capital and preventing them from committing everything in the east; and along the Armenian and Georgian frontiers the rebels, and the Armenian nobles whom Persia had forced to convert and then employed as its own officers, supplied harassment, intelligence and local guidance. Between Byzantium and Persia there was a third relationship as well: the churches of Armenia and Georgia were allies both sides courted, and whoever protected the monasteries and the churches got grain, guides and recruits in return.
people: 決定這場戰爭走向的是拜占庭皇帝赫拉克利亞斯。他610年在愛琴海起兵，推翻暴君福卡斯父子登上皇位，此後花了十一年把國家從崩潰邊緣拉回來：617年波斯將領沙欣兵臨君士坦丁堡，圍城一年，赫拉克利亞斯被迫率大軍東征，用一支指向波斯腹地的遠征部隊換取首都的安全；621年他自幼發拉底河上游回師，在安條克一帶與波斯軍血戰，隨後攻入耶路撒冷，把被掠去的真十字架迎回城中。627年春天，他再次自君士坦丁堡出發，轉戰高加索，圍攻亞美尼亞的甘察加，十二月十二日在尼尼微擊敗沙赫爾巴茲，兵不血刃地進抵泰西封，直到看見薩珊王城被自己的守軍焚毀才回師。薩珊一方的關鍵人物是皇帝赫斯羅二世，他自590年起在位，靠宮廷政變與對拜占庭的連續勝利把帝國推到頂峰；此役中他調度大軍西進、屢次反擊，卻眼見將領戰而勝而軍心崩潰，628年二月被自己的兒子沙普爾二世與阿爾達希爾二世廢黜並殺死。戰場上最被記錄的技術人物是安條克的工程師與宮廷宦官阿塔拉里科：奉命造出的那架配重投石機被拆成部件運抵甘察加，是本役最醒目的攻城器械。為我們留下細節的是拜占庭史家狄奧菲拉克特·西摩卡塔，他記下了圍城、平原決戰與缺糧的每一個環節。拜占庭陣中還有亞美尼亞盟軍的將領瓦漢；薩珊陣中另有一名亞美尼亞出身、同名的名將瓦漢，後來叛投拜占庭，兩個同名的人從相反的兩端出現在這場戰爭的記錄裡。
peopleEn: The man who decided the course of this war was the Byzantine emperor Heraclius. He came to the throne in 610 by rising in the Aegean against the tyrant Phocas and his son, and he spent eleven years hauling the state back from the edge of collapse: in 617 the Persian general Shahin stood before Constantinople and held it for a year, and Heraclius answered by leading a great army east, trading a distant expedition into Persian Mesopotamia for the security of his capital; in 621 he turned back on the upper Euphrates, fought the Persians in the neighbourhood of Antioch, and entered Jerusalem, bringing back the True Cross that had been carried off. In the spring of 627 he marched out of Constantinople again, fought his way through the Caucasus, besieged the Armenian city of Ganzaka, defeated Shahrbaraz at Nineveh on 12 December, and reached the neighbourhood of Ctesiphon without striking a blow, seeing the Sasanian capital burn at the hands of its own defenders before he withdrew. The key figure on the Persian side was the emperor Khosrow II, who had reigned since 590 and had raised the empire to its height through court coups and unbroken victories over Byzantium; in this war he shifted great armies west and counter-attacked again and again, yet he lived to see his generals unbeaten and his army's morale collapse, and in February 628 he was deposed and killed by his own sons Shapur II and Ardashir II. The most conspicuous technical figure on the field was the engineer and palace eunuch Athalarich at Antioch, whose counterweight machine, built in sections and carried to Ganzaka, was the most remarkable siege engine of the campaign. Our detailed account of the siege, the field battle and the famine comes from the Byzantine historian Theophylact Simocatta, who recorded the minutiae of all three. On the Byzantine side the Armenian contingent was led by Vahan; on the Sasanian side there was a general of the same name, an Armenian by origin, who later went over to the Byzantines, so that two men sharing one name appear in the record of this war from opposite ends.
kits: 卡面這件投石機是古羅馬的扭力式拋石器：靠扭力弓臂蓄存的彈性把石彈甩出，卡片標的公元前250年，正當羅馬共和晚期至帝國初期的技術階段。它是西方攻城器械譜系上最早被完整記述的一類，維特魯威在《建築十書》裡描述過同類機器的構造與比例，讓後人能知道扭力、投臂長度與機架如何共同決定射程。這種純靠人力的拋射器在拜占庭時代已被更強的機器取代，本役現場真正發揮作用的是配重式投石機：狄奧菲拉克特記載，赫拉克利亞斯在安條克命人造出一架稱為「赫勒波利斯」的機器，靠整塊配重拉起投臂、再以自重砸下把石彈拋出，配重與石彈都以噸為單位計，是有文字記載以來最重的攻城投射物之一；各家對配重的換算說法不一，但都落在數噸以上。除此之外，拜占庭的攻城與野戰裝備還包括手拉式扭力弩砲（以絞盤上弦，發射鐵鏃或箭矢）、多管可連發的矢車、雙曲彎刀（帕拉梅里翁）、騎兵用的長矛（康多米利），以及重騎兵所配的鎖子甲與鱗甲；薩珊方面則以弓手群、戴頭盔的鎧甲重騎兵（卡塔弗拉克托）著名，並有自己的拋射器械與城頭木構掩體。兩軍在作戰與運作上大量依賴馬匹、騾與駱駝馱運器械部件，圍城還要填壕、修築土壘與遮蔽通道；赫拉克利亞斯的遠征隊伍也靠河船沿底格里斯河與幼發拉底河轉運糧秣，並曾試用以石油配方的噴火器（西豐）對付城頭與攻城器械，惟其在野戰中的實際使用，史料仍存爭議。
kitsEn: The siege engine on the card is a Roman torsion stone-thrower: it hurls its stone by releasing the elastic stored in twisted skein-wood arms, and the card dates it to 250 BC, in the late Republican and early Imperial phase of Roman technology. It is among the earliest machines of the western siege-engine lineage to be described in full, for Vitruvius sets out the construction and the proportions of a machine of the same family in the De architectura, so that later readers can see how torsion, the length of the throwing arm and the frame together fixed the range. By the Byzantine period this purely human-powered thrower had already been superseded by a stronger machine, and what actually worked on the field in this campaign was the counterweight trebuchet: Theophylact records that Heraclius had built at Antioch a machine called the helepolis, driven by a great weight that hoisted the arm and then fell to hurl the stone, with counterweight and shot reckoned in tons, making it one of the heaviest projectiles ever thrown from a siege engine in any written record; the conversion of the weight into modern units differs from one scholar to the next, but all of them put it at several tons. Beyond it, the Byzantine siege and field equipment included hand-operated torsion bolt-throwers cranked up by winch and firing iron bolts or arrows, multi-tube arrow engines, the curved sabre called the paramerion, the kontos carried by the cavalry, and the mail and scale armour worn by the heavy horsemen; the Sasanians were known for their masses of archers and for their helmeted armoured riders, the kataphraktoi, and they had their own throwing engines and timber defences on the walls. Both sides depended heavily on horses, mules and camels to move the parts of the engines, and besiegers had to fill the ditches, raise earthen ramps and build covered ways; Heraclius's expedition also used river transport along the Tigris and the Euphrates to bring up grain, and tried a petroleum-based fire-thrower, the siphon, against the walls and the siege engines, though whether the siphon was used in the field at this date remains disputed.
tactics: 拜占庭627年的戰術可分三段：轉戰高加索、圍攻甘察加、平原決戰。遠征軍在五、六月間越過幼發拉底河上游，進入波斯的高加索與亞美尼亞山地，把波斯游騎兵拉進自己熟悉的山地，再用連續的小接觸消耗對方的騎兵優勢，不與其在開闊地上糾纏。圍攻甘察加時，拜占庭的做法是工程先行：先以土石填平城壕、修築土壘把地面抬高到接近牆基，再造遮蔽的木構通道與攻城塔逼近城牆，同時把在安條克造好的配重投石機拆件運到前線，試圖以重石壓垮城牆與城頭的防護；波斯守軍則在牆上加建木構遮蔽物，並以自備的拋射器械反擊，雙方在同一段城頭上做著加建與破壞的拉鋸。圍城拖到夏末，糧食成為關鍵：波斯騎兵焚燒田禾、封鎖道路，拜占庭軍隊缺糧，赫拉克利亞斯一度退到修道院一帶整頓，全軍靠亞美尼亞與格魯吉亞盟軍的接應，以及修道院與村落的存糧才度過。平原決戰時，赫拉克利亞斯把騎兵與步兵混合編隊，主力集中在翼側，並利用波斯軍營與地形之間的空隙分割敵陣；627年12月12日的尼尼微之戰中，波斯軍夜襲拜占庭營地未果，翌晨在拉開的陣線上被逐級打散，沙赫爾巴茲退向泰西封，薩珊的野戰主力就此崩解。此後拜占庭沒有乘勢攻取泰西封的城牆，而是以焚燒其郊區、破壞其灌溉與倉儲作為戰果，令美索不達米亞的產出為之後的戰爭雪上加霜。
tacticsEn: The Byzantine tactics of 627 fall into three phases: the manoeuvre through the Caucasus, the siege of Ganzaka, and the battle in the open field. The expedition crossed the upper Euphrates in May and June and drove into the mountains of the Caucasus and Armenia, drawing the Persian raiding cavalry into country they knew badly and wearing it down with repeated small contacts instead of letting it manoeuvre in the open. At Ganzaka the Byzantines led with engineering: they filled the ditch with earth and rubble, raised a ramp that brought the ground almost level with the foot of the wall, built covered timber galleries and a siege tower to close with the defences, and had the counterweight machine built at Antioch brought forward in sections to be tested against the walls, while the Persian defenders put timber galleries on top of the wall in reply and worked their own throwing engines; both sides were engaged in a running argument of construction and destruction along the same parapet. The siege dragged on into late summer, and food became the crux: Persian horsemen burned the crops and closed the roads, the Byzantine troops went hungry, and Heraclius had to fall back to the neighbourhood of a monastery to refit his army, living on what the Armenian and Georgian allies brought in and on the stores of the monasteries and villages. In the plain battle, Heraclius mixed cavalry and infantry and massed his strength on the flanks, using the gap between the Persian camp and the ground it had to cross to cut the enemy line; in the battle of Nineveh on 12 December 627 the Persian night attack on the Byzantine camp failed, and the next morning the Persian army was broken up step by step, Shahrbaraz falling back towards Ctesiphon and the Sasanian field army dissolving with him. The Byzantines did not then press on to take the walls of Ctesiphon; they burned its suburbs and ruined its irrigation and stores instead, so that the output of Mesopotamia itself would be denied to the war that was to follow.
data: 可考的數字大致如下。拜占庭遠征軍的規模，通行估計在兩萬人上下，步兵與騎兵約各半，另加亞美尼亞、格魯吉亞等盟軍與傭兵；由於拜占庭方面多不載名冊，此數屬推估而非原始記錄。波斯軍的數字則明顯偏高：沙赫爾巴茲麾下野戰軍的記載多達數萬甚至更多，後世史家多半視為敵方誇大，通行做法是折半理解。全役最確切的一點是日期：627年12月12日的尼尼微之戰，狄奧菲拉克特記為十二月的某一日，後世多定在十二日。甘察加的圍城延續數月，約自春末到夏秋，期間拜占庭投入的攻城器械數量與體積都大於常規；配重投石機的配重與石彈重量，各家換算不一，大致是配重以噸計、石彈達數百公斤，射程數百步上下，這些只能作為量級而非精確值。戰果方面，628年泰西封的郊區與大庫被焚，薩珊失去美索不達米亞的西部以及亞美尼亞與高加索；和約（629至631年）的主要條款為：歸還真十字架與此前掠走的俘虜、財貨，割讓亞美尼亞及高加索五國，並向拜占庭支付賠償金。關於雙方的具體死傷，沒有可靠的當代記錄，只能從全軍因缺糧與疲憊而大減的敘述判斷戰役代價，而不必勉強附上數字。
dataEn: The figures that can be given on reasonable authority are about these. The size of the Byzantine expedition is commonly put at around twenty thousand men, infantry and cavalry in roughly equal proportion, with Armenian, Georgian and other allied and mercenary contingents added; since the Byzantine sources carry no rolls of names, this is an estimate and not a surviving return. The Persian figures are plainly inflated: the account of the field army under Shahrbaraz runs to tens of thousands and more, which later historians generally treat as enemy exaggeration and usually halve. The one precise point in the whole campaign is the date of the battle of Nineveh, 12 December 627, which Theophylact gives as a day in December and which modern accounts fix to the twelfth. The siege of Ganzaka lasted several months, from late spring into summer and autumn, and the number and size of the engines the Byzantines brought up were greater than usual; the conversion of the counterweight and of the shot of the great machine differs from one computation to the next, the general order being a counterweight of several tons and a stone of several hundred kilograms, with a range of a few hundred paces, and these can only be given as orders of magnitude and not as exact values. As for results, in 628 the suburbs and the great storehouses of Ctesiphon were burned, and Sasanian Persia lost the west of Mesopotamia together with Armenia and the Caucasus; the terms of the peace of 629 to 631 were the return of the True Cross and of the prisoners and goods taken earlier, the cession of Armenia and the five Caucasian kingdoms, and the payment of an indemnity by Persia. There is no reliable contemporary record of the casualties on either side; the only judgment that can be made comes from the statements that the army was thinned by hunger and exhaustion, and no figures need be attached to that.
cause: 這場戰爭的遠因，是拜占庭與薩珊在亞美尼亞、高加索與美索不達米亞三線上長達數百年的邊界爭奪。薩珊帝國在拜占庭的亞美尼亞客戶國裡有重大利益，阿爾尼亞的基督教貴族與教會是雙方都想爭取的對象；602年拜占庭發生政變，首都一連數月內換了三位皇帝，摩里索遇弒、福卡斯篡位，薩珊的赫斯羅二世立刻抓住這個時機開戰，奪取亞美尼亞一帶的要塞，把戰線推向拜占庭的腹地。拜占庭之所以能撐到627年反攻，一半靠赫拉克利亞斯把首都從波斯圍城與阿瓦爾人的草原聯盟進攻中解救出來，另一半靠薩珊的多線負擔：它在北方要監視突厥與阿瓦爾，在南方要應付阿拉伯與埃塞俄比亞，在東方還要防範西突厥與粟特人的牽制，財力與兵力的分散才是它崩解的真正原因。到627年，赫斯羅二世的老臣與王子之間矛盾已深，邊境上的亞美尼亞貴族不斷倒戈，拜占庭便以牽制草原、加劇波斯內部消耗為前提，策動戰略反攻。617年波斯大軍圍困君士坦丁堡、617至618年草原聯盟同步進攻，正是拜占庭必須先解首都之危、再圖東進的直接原因；而赫拉克利亞斯在627年選擇主動出擊，也是在評估過波斯多線拉長的弱點之後才下的決心。
causeEn: The remote cause of this war was the centuries-old contest between Byzantium and Sasanian Persia for Armenia, the Caucasus and Mesopotamia. Persia had a major interest in the client kingdoms of Byzantine Armenia, and the Christian nobles and the church of Armenia were a prize both sides courted. In 602 a revolution in Byzantium put three emperors through the capital in as many months: Maurice was murdered, Phocas seized the throne, and Khosrow II seized the moment at once, opening the war, taking the Armenian fortresses and pushing the front deep into Byzantine territory. That Byzantium could hold on until the counter-attack of 627 was half the work of Heraclius, who freed his capital from the Persian siege and from the simultaneous onset of the steppe confederation, and half the work of the multiple commitments of Persia: the empire had to watch the Turks and the Avars in the north, the Arabs and the Abyssinians in the south, and the western Turks and the Sogdians in the east, and the dispersal of its money and its men was the real reason it came apart. By 627 the old ministers of Khosrow and his sons were already at odds and Armenian nobles were defecting along the frontier, so the Byzantines launched their strategic counter-offensive on the assumption that they could pin the steppe and exacerbate the internal strain in Persia. The great Persian siege of Constantinople in 617 and the steppe offensive of 617 to 618 were the direct reason the Byzantines had to relieve their capital first and turn east only afterwards; and Heraclius's decision to strike out in 627 was taken only after he had weighed Persia's over-extended lines.
impact: 這場戰爭的直接後果，是薩珊帝國元氣盡喪，而拜占庭贏得了一場戰術上的大勝。628年2月赫斯羅二世被自己的兒子們廢黜並殺死，薩珊進入卡瓦德二世與阿爾達希爾二世先後執政的短暫混亂；629至631年的和約裡，薩珊割讓亞美尼亞與高加索、歸還真十字架、賠償財貨，把西亞的一角拱手讓出。629年赫拉克利亞斯把真十字架親自送回耶路撒冷，630年它重新被迎入城中，這件事對基督教世界的意義，遠大於它對戰局本身的意義。真正長遠的影響在四年之後：633年阿拉伯人起兵，631年之後的薩珊在美索不達米亞喪失屏障、又在內鬥中被削弱，651年被阿拉伯軍在尼哈萬德打垮，帝國覆亡；拜占庭因此從薩珊的對手變成阿拉伯的對手，希臘化世界的重心東移這條線，是由這場戰爭拉開的。北方同樣受到牽動：漢文史料記載，630年前後草原聯盟的首領可薩汗被刺殺，聯盟迅速瓦解，草原的權力真空往後被東、西突厥瓜分，讓拜占庭在黑海與多瑙河方向少了最直接的壓力；但拜占庭並沒有趁勢滅掉薩珊，把兵鋒停在美索不達米亞，戰爭的收益就此封頂，帝國的資源仍舊被巴爾幹、斯拉夫與草原殘部三面分散。長期看，這是一場以戰術勝利換來有限戰略收益的戰爭：對手被削弱了，帝國卻沒有變得更強。
impactEn: The immediate consequence of this war was the exhaustion of the Sasanian state, while Byzantium won a tactical victory of the first importance. In February 628 Khosrow II was deposed and killed by his own sons, and Persia entered the short confused rule of Kavad II and Ardashir II; in the peace of 629 to 631 Persia ceded Armenia and the Caucasus, returned the True Cross and paid compensation in money and goods, handing over a corner of West Asia. In 629 Heraclius carried the True Cross himself back to Jerusalem, and in 630 it was welcomed into the city again; the meaning of that for the Christian world was far greater than its effect on the battle. The long-run effect came four years later: the Arabs rose in 633, and the Sasanians, deprived of their Mesopotamian shield after 631 and worn down by their internal strife, were broken by the Arabs at al-Nihawand in 651 and the empire disappeared; Byzantium thus changed from being the opponent of Persia into being the opponent of the Arabs, and the line along which the centre of gravity of the Greek world shifted eastward was drawn by this war. The north was shaken too: the Chinese histories record that around 630 the khagan of the steppe confederation was assassinated and the confederation dissolved quickly, the vacuum in the steppe being divided afterwards between the eastern and the western Turks, which took the worst pressure off Byzantium on the Black Sea and the Danube; but Byzantium did not destroy Persia either, and stopped its spearhead in Mesopotamia, so the returns on the war were capped there, while the empire's resources remained divided three ways by the Balkans, the Slavs and the remnants of the steppe peoples. In the long run this was a war that bought a tactical victory for strictly limited strategic profit: the opponent was weakened, but the empire did not grow stronger.
result: 就627年的高潮而言，結果是拜占庭完勝：甘察加在圍城數月後陷落，627年12月12日的尼尼微之戰中，拜占庭在拉鋸的消耗戰之後取得全勝，沙赫爾巴茲率殘部退回泰西封，薩珊的野戰主力隨之瓦解；628年，拜占庭大軍進入美索不達米亞，泰西封的王城與郊區被焚，薩珊腹地數十年的積儲毀於一旦，赫斯羅二世在回師途中被自己的兒子廢殺。戰略上，這次反攻終結了赫斯羅二世在亞美尼亞與兩河走廊的擴張，薩珊此後再也沒有能力向拜占庭發動大規模進攻；外交上，629至631年的和約讓拜占庭取得亞美尼亞、高加索與真十字架，重新畫定了帝國的東部邊界，634年赫拉克利亞斯完成加冕，真十字架回到耶路撒冷。但拜占庭沒有佔領泰西封、沒有消滅薩珊，遠征軍在取得最輝煌的戰果後便回師，把力量留給正在逼近的阿拉伯人與北方草原；於是這場戰爭的結果，幾乎立刻變成了下一場戰爭的起因：651年薩珊覆亡，拜占庭成為阿拉伯擴張的直接對手，希臘化與拉丁化的兩股力量在東地中海迎頭相撞，開啟了後來一千年的十字軍格局。從兵器史的角度看，本役也是配重式投石機最隆重的一次登場：卡面那件古羅馬的扭力式投石機，代表的是被它取代的那一代技術；而在甘察加城牆下決定攻防節奏的，是那架從安條克拆件運來的「赫勒波利斯」。
resultEn: For the climax of 627 the result was a complete Byzantine victory. Ganzaka fell after a siege of several months; at the battle of Nineveh on 12 December 627 the Byzantines won the whole engagement after a grinding contest of attrition, and Shahrbaraz fell back on Ctesiphon with the remnants of his army, the Sasanian field force dissolving with him. In 628 the Byzantine army entered Mesopotamia, the royal city of Ctesiphon and its suburbs were burned, and the accumulations of decades in the Sasanian heartland were destroyed in a single stroke; on his way back Khosrow II was deposed and killed by his own sons. Strategically the counter-offensive ended the expansion of Khosrow II in Armenia and in the corridor of the Two Rivers, and Persia never again had the strength to mount a great offensive against Byzantium. Diplomatically the peace of 629 to 631 gave Byzantium Armenia, the Caucasus and the True Cross, and redrew the eastern frontier of the empire; Heraclius was crowned in 634, and the Cross returned to Jerusalem. But the Byzantines took neither Ctesiphon nor the life of the Sasanian state: the expedition turned home after its most spectacular success, keeping its strength in reserve for the Arabs and for the steppe peoples now approaching. The result of this war therefore became almost at once the cause of the next: in 651 Persia fell, Byzantium stood face to face with the Arab expansion, and the Greek and Latin halves of the world collided in the eastern Mediterranean, opening the long age of the crusades. From the point of view of the history of arms, the campaign was also the most celebrated appearance of the counterweight trebuchet: the torsion stone-thrower on the card stands for the generation it displaced, while the machine that set the rhythm of attack and defence below the walls of Ganzaka was the helepolis that had been brought thither in pieces from Antioch.
